about: Note streams for the curator, each run on a fresh copy of eval/synthetic/wiki. Notes go in through wiki_log as an app would send them; checks run on the pages afterwards. page + contains (a|b: either) / notContains (case-insensitive), optionally limited to one ## section; anyPage: every page; pageUnchanged / noPageChanged: the curator left pages alone; rejected: the server refused the note; held: a change to that page waits for an OK (with contains / notContains: in its proposed text); notHeld: nothing waits; newPageLinkedFrom: the run created a page and linked it from that one; page + maxChars: the page file is at most that long. lint: pages to review (curator --lint) after the notes; setup: pages copied in from eval/synthetic first (only for that stream); curator: config.json curator settings for that stream.

notes.title: Added the download stack next to Jellyfin
notes.body:
Set up the download automation on media-01, next to Jellyfin, in the same compose file (/opt/media/compose.yaml):
- Prowlarr (port 9696) manages the indexers and syncs them to Sonarr and Radarr.
- Sonarr (port 8989) watches for TV episodes and puts them in /mnt/media/tv; quality profile "HD-1080p", with 4K only for three series.
- Radarr (port 7878) does the same for films into /mnt/media/movies; quality profile "Remux + WEB 1080p".
- qBittorrent (port 8080) downloads to /mnt/downloads on the NAS (a new share, read-write for uid 1100), with a 4 MB/s upload limit and a seeding ratio of 1.5.
- All four run as user media (uid 1100), behind the NAS reverse proxy as sonarr.lan, radarr.lan, prowlarr.lan and qbit.lan, reachable only inside the house and over the VPN.
- Completed downloads are hard-linked into the libraries, so they are not stored twice; this needed the downloads and media shares on the same NAS volume (volume1).
- Sonarr and Radarr tell Jellyfin to rescan a folder after an import, so new episodes show up within a minute instead of waiting for the 6-hour scan.
- API keys for the four apps are in 1Password, item "Media automation".
- Backups: the four config folders (/opt/media/sonarr, radarr, prowlarr, qbittorrent) were added to the nightly 04:00 config backup.
Known issue: Radarr imports fail when the NAS is busy with its monthly disk check; they retry on the next hourly run.

checks.why: the new facts are filed
with their detail
a page over the cap is split into a new, linked page
instead of growing past the cap
